Canvas Extensions：Windows Figma 桌面端通用扩展注入器。

下载 CanvasExtensions-0.6.5-win-x64.exe，单文件自包含，无需另装 .NET。附送 GIF 画布预览 0.2.8 和纹理批量导出 0.2.6；预装与外置扩展使用相同 module.json 和公共 SDK。保存并退出 Figma 后应用扩展，重新打开文档自动加载。

A modular extension injector for Figma Desktop on Windows. Download the standalone x64 EXE below. Includes two ordinary directory extensions using the same public SDK as custom extensions. GPL-3.0-only; third-party font/icon licenses retained.

Source, SDK, screenshots and build instructions: https://github.com/dreamstring/CanvasExtensions
